title: printing.jobs.create payload
description: A print intention, in the shape the hub's print queue takes (`PrintIntent`, hub/crates/runtime/src/host_print.rs). camelCase on purpose: they are `NewPrintJob`'s names, the ones the shell already speaks.

jobId.description: Idempotency key chosen by the caller: two requests with the same jobId are ONE ticket.

documentType.description: Which document this is — the queue's closed vocabulary (print_queue::DOCUMENT_TYPES).

document.description: The structured document the renderer prints (never HTML, hub#501).

role.description: Optional station override (receipt/kitchen/bar/label). Absent = the hub resolves the station from documentType (hub#987).
